messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staggered deploy to prod · env=prod · region=us-west-2 · commit=release/v1.8.2 · tag=rdw-1.8.2

sam: plan: runtime -> api -> console. 5m stabilization gap between services. console will be optional pin depending on health.

deploy-bot: runtime rollout started — group=runtime-pool-7 · image=rdw-runtime:rdw-1.8.2 · strategy=canary(10%->50%->100%)

riya: LGTM for runtime. watching latency dashboard r-inference/prod/latency (p95 + p50).

ben: proposal: hold console at v1.8.1 for now — UI change has a known regression. proceed with runtime+api, pin console if any instability.

sam: ok pin console -> v1.8.1 (no change). api/runtimes proceed as planned. I'll leave a note in release checklist.

deploy-bot: runtime canary steps completed: 10%->50%->100% in ~4m. status=SUCCESS · artifacts=rdw-runtime:rdw-1.8.2

ops-bot: ALERT: api canary: spike of 501's at 14:06 UTC for /v1/chat · error_rate=0.8% (threshold=0.5%)

sam: pausing api canary. scaling down to 25% traffic and switching to fallback model variant (quantized). @riya please check traces and kernel logs.

riya: looking now — root cause looks like kernel OOMs on some g4dn-s instances during long-context requests. increasing autoscaler by +2 instances and applying kernel-hotfix config.

deploy-bot: api status update: PAUSED · current_traffic=25% · reason=error spike · action=pinned_console(v1.8.1)

ben: if api doesn't recover within 12m we rollback api to v1.8.1. set rollback timer for 12m.

sam: +1 on rollback timeout. alerting #oncall and tagging infra.

deploy-bot: api resumed at 30% after hotfix · error_rate=0.12% · progressing to 60% in 3m per rollout plan.

riya: traces show kernel-hotfix reduced OOMs; latency stable. recommending continue.

sam: continuing rollout. schedule console stage for maintenance window tomorrow 02:00 PDT (separate change window).

deploy-bot: Deploy finished · final status: runtime=SUCCESS · api=SUCCESS(after pause+hotfix) · console=PINNED(v1.8.1)

ben: closing loop — short release note: "v1.8.2: runtime+api rolled to prod; console deferred/pinned at v1.8.1; brief api canary pause due to kernel OOMs, hotfix applied; no user-facing regressions observed."

sam: adding follow-up: INF-1347 — investigate kernel regression, increase autoscale buffer for g4dn-s pools.

deploy-bot: Release artifacts pushed: tag rdw-1.8.2 · registry=artifacts.redwood.internal/releases/rdw-1.8.2

riya: thanks all. will draft postmortem-ish blurb if anything else crops up in next 24h.

ben: :thumbsup: nice recovery and coordination.
